-- Module:WorldBossTimetable
-- Builds the weekly World Boss timetable of Template:WorldBossTimetable from Module:WorldBossData.
-- The page is built in server time (New York), the script in MediaWiki:Common.js moves every spawn to the
-- reader's time zone. Without the script the readers simply see the server times.
local p = {}

local data = require('Module:WorldBossData')

local DAYS = { 'MON', 'TUE', 'WED', 'THU', 'FRI', 'SAT', 'SUN' }
local DAYKEY = { Mon = 0, Tue = 1, Wed = 2, Thu = 3, Fri = 4, Sat = 5, Sun = 6 }

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function minutes(hhmm)
	local h, m = tostring(hhmm):match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
	if not h then return nil end
	return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local function clock(min)
	return string.format('%02d:%02d', math.floor(min / 60), min % 60)
end

-- a boss name, each part links to its page when that page exists (no red links)
local exists = {}
local function pageExists(page)
	if exists[page] == nil then
		local t = mw.title.new(page)
		exists[page] = (t and t.exists) and true or false
	end
	return exists[page]
end

local function nameHtml(boss, link)
	if not link or not boss.parts then return esc(boss.name) end
	local out = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(boss.parts) do
		if part[2] and (part[3] or pageExists(part[2])) then
			out[#out + 1] = '[[' .. part[2] .. '|' .. esc(part[1]) .. ']]'
		else
			out[#out + 1] = esc(part[1])
		end
	end
	return table.concat(out, ' / ')
end

local function file(name, alt)
	return '[[File:' .. name .. '|56px|link=|alt=' .. esc(alt) .. ']]'
end

-- the picture of a boss, a random slot of two bosses is split in half
local function icon(boss)
	local box = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('wbt-ico')
	if boss.ring then box:addClass('wbt-ring-' .. boss.cls) end
	if #boss.icons == 1 then
		box:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-pic'):wikitext(file(boss.icons[1], boss.name))
	else
		box:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-pic wbt-pic-l'):wikitext(file(boss.icons[1], boss.name))
		box:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-pic wbt-pic-r'):wikitext(file(boss.icons[2], boss.name))
	end
	return box
end

local function event(slot, boss, link)
	local ev = mw.html.create('div')
		:addClass('wbt-ev wbt-c-' .. boss.cls)
		:attr('data-day', slot.day)
		:attr('data-min', slot.min)
	ev:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-time'):wikitext(clock(slot.min))
	ev:node(icon(boss))
	local text = ev:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-text')
	text:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-name'):wikitext(nameHtml(boss, link))
	if boss.sub then text:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-sub'):wikitext(esc(boss.sub)) end
	text:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-nexttag'):wikitext('NEXT SPAWN')
	return ev
end

function p.main(frame)
	local a = frame.args
	local layout = trim(a.layout):lower()
	if layout ~= 'week' and layout ~= 'agenda' then layout = 'auto' end
	local header = trim(a.header):lower() ~= 'no'
	-- mode=next: only the next spawn bar (for the Main Page), the table itself stays hidden and feeds the script
	local mini = trim(a.mode):lower() == 'next'
	if mini then header = false end

	-- slots of the data page in order of the day and time
	local byDay = {}
	for d = 0, 6 do byDay[d] = {} end
	for _, s in ipairs(data.slots) do
		local boss = data.bosses[s[1]]
		local day = DAYKEY[s[2]]
		local min = minutes(s[3])
		if boss and day and min then
			table.insert(byDay[day], { day = day, min = min, boss = boss })
		end
	end

	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('wbt wbt-' .. layout)
	if mini then
		root:addClass('wbt-mini')
		local bar = root:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-next'):attr('data-label', 'NEXT WORLD BOSS')
		local target = data.nextPage and mw.title.new(data.nextPage)
		if target then bar:attr('data-href', target:localUrl()) end
	end

	if header then
		local top = root:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-top')
		top:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-next')
		local tz = top:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-tz')
		tz:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-tzlabel'):wikitext('Time zone')
		tz:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-tzname'):wikitext('Server time (New York)')
	end

	local days = root:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-days')
	for d = 0, 6 do
		local col = days:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-day')
		local head = col:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-dayhead')
		head:tag('span'):wikitext(DAYS[d + 1])
		head:tag('span'):addClass('wbt-today'):wikitext('TODAY')
		local list = col:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-events')
		table.sort(byDay[d], function(x, y) return x.min < y.min end)
		for _, s in ipairs(byDay[d]) do
			list:node(event(s, s.boss, not mini))
		end
	end

	if header then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('wbt-note'):wikitext('Times adjust to your time zone. Without scripts they show server time (New York).')
	end

	return tostring(root)
end

return p
